summary.headline: Astrological Codices 6–7
summary.text: Descriptions of Milanese codices 6 and 7: codex 6 preserves astrological material on the seven planets, Hermes Trismegistus on earthquakes, Orphic verses, zodiac-sign genders, benefic stars, and planetary separation; codex 7 includes chapters on the earth, antipodes, paradise, the four seas, Ocean, and zodiac-sign rulership.
